name: v2-presigned-account-acl-swap-fails
note:
the signature is over the string to sign of a URL used with X-Amz-Acl: private and X-Goog-Acl: public-read, which rgw-go signs as PUT


1441000000
x-amz-acl:private
/b/k, computed with Python's hmac and hashlib; radosgw signs both requests as the joined line x-amz-acl:private,public-read, so the swap verifies there and its canned ACL becomes public-read, while rgw-go signs the swapped X-Amz-Acl alone, so the signature fails
